sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; selected Setup Complete from the same table after dedupe because it has concrete coding-agent supply-chain experiments and defense details.

Read arXiv metadata, PDF, HTML, TeX source, and appendix; extracted threat model, scenarios, harness-model ablation, mitigation prompts, cross-ecosystem validation, limitations, and pre-install hook design.
Mapped the 12 scenarios, 5 attack classes, 9 harness-model configurations, R9 CVE battery, source attacks, and PreToolUse gate into tables, formulas, pseudocode, and a state machine.

Marked boundaries around synthetic repositories, hosted model drift, limited false-positive evidence, construction-specific hook coverage, missing resolved-set gate, and limited third-party follow-up.
Searched exact title, arXiv ID, and Sentinel repository terms; found no substantive independent reproduction beyond source and aggregation pages, so the article states that boundary.
Wrote pure Markdown with self-contained TL;DR, claim-mechanism-evidence-boundary table, scenario tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid diagrams, Figure/Table evidence, and explicit limitations.
